g.title: PROJECT
g.text: CAD → ANSYS JC model → ML model → USERMAT in ANSYS → critical length

g.title: ep
g.text: hardening baseline, same mesh and load

g.title: sel
g.text: Train and select on the 36 training cases only

g.title: lock
g.text: final, never retrained on test cases

g.title: test
g.text: Scored once on the 37 test cases

g.title: um
g.text: USERMAT generated from the locked weights
J2 radial return + JC-PINN flow stress + tangent
checked offline (2e-15) and in MAPDL single element

g.title: sim
g.text: UY = +2 mm on the pin bore · porosity sweep · mesh study

g.title: res
g.text: after yield it depends on the mesh

g.title: cl
g.text: Predict the critical length from the bracket results
method and inputs still to be decided
the repository has no flaw or toughness data so far

g.title: limits
g.text: simulated data, nothing experimentally validated · units user-confirmed
nothing validated above 200 °C · strain is total (M4) · test is not blind
